name: @pipeworx/mcp-bankruptcy

tools.name: bankruptcy_search
tools.description: Find US BUSINESS BANKRUPTCY filings by company name. Searches 1.55 million business filings across federal bankruptcy courts — no API key. Returns the case name, docket number, court, filing date, termination date and assigned judge. Use for "has this company filed for bankruptcy", corporate distress checks, counterparty risk and due diligence. Individual consumer bankruptcies are deliberately excluded.

company.description: Company name or a distinctive part of it, e.g. "Kmart".

court.description: Optional court id, e.g. "cacb" (C.D. Cal. Bankruptcy).

filed_after.description: Only filings on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

filed_before.description: Only filings on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: bankruptcy_recent
tools.description: List recent US business bankruptcy filings, newest first, optionally limited to one bankruptcy court. No API key, no rate limit. Use for "what companies filed for bankruptcy recently" or to watch one district. Returns case name, docket number, court, filing and termination dates.

filed_after.description: Only filings on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bankruptcy forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bankruptcy pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
